@Usage:@: @   2. Copy pico.js/css, index.html/js from pico to public directory.                            @
@   3. Build app.js from each pico/$app directories.                                             @
@   4. Copy pico.js/css, index.html/js from each pico/$app to each public/$app directories.      @
@   Deploy public directory to saikororg on firebase.                                            @
scripts.build:lib: pushd pico; npm run build --main=public --out=../; popd
scripts.build:app: pushd pico; for app in dice clock bank kuku chess shogi; do npm run build --main=app/$app --out=../public; done; popd
scripts.build: npm run build:lib; npm run build:app
